findings.title: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) — Remote Code Execution via Jinja2
findings.description: The driver application form at /submit reflects user input from the 'name' field directly into a Jinja2 template without sanitization. An attacker can inject Jinja2 template expressions that are evaluated server-side, achieving full Remote Code Execution as root. The application runs on Flask/Werkzeug (Python 3.10.20) and processes the name field with render_template_string or equivalent.
